minced-meat-sauce: A hearty woodland ragout of boar, neck meat, and carrot.
Brown chopped boar and poultry or lizard meat; add diced carrot, water, salt, and herbs, then simmer until thick.
queens-jam: A bright preserve combining two kinds of forest berries.
Simmer raspberries and blueberries with a little sugar and lemon until glossy; cool before serving.
carrot-soup: A simple mushroom-and-carrot soup built for long journeys.
Soften mushrooms and carrots in butter, add stock, simmer until tender, then blend and season.
deer-stew: A rich venison stew balanced with carrot and blueberries.
Brown venison, then gently braise it with carrot, stock, herbs, and a spoonful of crushed blueberries.
muckshake: A strange sweet-tart berry drink inspired by the Swamp.
Blend raspberries and blueberries with yogurt, lime, honey, and a pinch of spirulina for its eerie color.
turnip-stew: A savory turnip and pork stew from the Swamp tier.
Brown pork, add cubed turnips and stock, then simmer with thyme until the vegetables are soft.
sausages: Rustic pork sausages fragranced with woodland herbs.
Mix ground pork with salt, pepper, garlic, and dried herbs; shape into links or patties and pan-cook thoroughly.
black-soup: A dark, earthy turnip soup with a bittersweet finish.
Roast turnip and beet, simmer with stock and onion, blend smooth, then balance with a little honey.
serpent-stew: A prized ocean stew pairing rich fish with mushroom and honey.
Sear firm white fish, then simmer briefly with mushrooms, seafood stock, herbs, and a touch of honey.
wolf-skewer: A mountain skewer of game meat, mushroom, and onion.
Thread venison or lamb, mushrooms, and onion onto skewers; season and grill until browned and cooked through.
eyescream: An icy blue fantasy dessert with a sharp, frosty look.
Churn vanilla ice cream with blueberry puree and lime zest; add candy eyes just before serving.
fish-wraps: Warm flatbread wrapped around flaky cooked fish.
Fill soft flatbreads with seasoned grilled fish, cabbage, herbs, and a spoonful of yogurt sauce.
lox-meat-pie: A substantial Plains pie filled with game and tart berries.
Encase browned beef or venison and crushed berries in pastry; vent and bake until deeply golden.
blood-pudding: A dark savory pudding inspired by Nordic blood sausage.
For an approachable version, combine barley, onion, beet puree, herbs, and sausage meat; bake until firm.
meat-platter: A Mistlands feast bringing together several roasted meats.
Roast small portions of beef, rabbit, and poultry with mushrooms; slice and arrange with pan juices.
honey-glazed-chicken: Roasted chicken lacquered with honey and mushrooms.
Brush chicken with honey, mustard, and salt; roast over mushrooms until caramelized and fully cooked.
misthare-supreme: A refined rabbit roast with mushroom and carrot.
Brown rabbit or chicken thighs, then roast with carrots, mushrooms, stock, and thyme until tender.
mushroom-omelette: A soft omelette generously filled with sautéed mushrooms.
Brown sliced mushrooms in butter, add beaten eggs, cook gently, fold, and finish with black pepper.
stuffed-mushroom: Large mushroom caps baked with a savory vegetable filling.
Fill mushroom caps with breadcrumbs, minced turnip, garlic, and herbs; bake until browned and juicy.
yggdrasil-porridge: A luminous fantasy porridge inspired by the world tree.
Simmer oats in milk until creamy; sweeten with maple syrup and top with blueberries and toasted seeds.
appalachili: A fiery Appalachian chili made from wasteland staples.
Brown ground beef with onion; add beans, tomato, chili powder, and hot sauce, then simmer until thick.
baked-bloatfly: A roasted insect dish reimagined as a crisp stuffed mushroom.
Stuff portobello caps with seasoned breadcrumbs and cheese; bake until crisp at the edges.
blackberry-honey-crisp: A warm berry crisp sweetened with honey.
Toss blackberries with honey and lemon; cover with an oat-butter crumble and bake until bubbling.
brain-bombs: A playful iced pastry with an unmistakably post-apocalyptic name.
Bake small spiced cakes, glaze with pink icing, and pipe looping lines on top for a brain-like finish.
cranberry-meatball-grinder: A toasted meatball sandwich sharpened by cranberry sauce.
Fill a roll with cooked meatballs, tomato sauce, and cranberry relish; top with cheese and broil.
deathclaw-wellington: A wasteland showpiece of meat and mushrooms wrapped in pastry.
Coat a seared beef fillet with mushroom duxelles, wrap in puff pastry, and bake until golden.
fasnacht-donut: A festive fried pastry dusted or glazed with sugar.
Cut rings from enriched yeast dough, fry until golden, then coat with cinnamon sugar or glaze.
fried-deerskins: A crunchy fried snack translated into seasoned venison strips.
Coat thin venison or beef strips in seasoned flour and shallow-fry until crisp and cooked through.
glowing-fungus-puree: A vivid, silky mushroom puree with an eerie green tint.
Sauté mushrooms and spinach with garlic, blend with stock and cream, then season with lemon.
iguana-soup: A clear, warming soup built around tender meat and vegetables.
Simmer chicken with onion, carrot, celery, herbs, and stock; shred the meat and return it to the pot.
mirelurk-cake-bloodleaf-aioli: A crab-style cake served with a crimson herb aioli.
Pan-fry crab cakes made with breadcrumbs and egg; serve with beet-tinted garlic mayonnaise.
pepperoni-roll: A West Virginia bread roll baked around pepperoni.
Wrap bread dough around pepperoni sticks and a little cheese; proof, then bake until browned.
pumpkin-pie: A familiar spiced custard pie made with pumpkin.
Whisk pumpkin puree with eggs, milk, sugar, and warm spices; pour into pastry and bake until set.
radscorpion-kebab: A smoky skewer translated into spicy shrimp and vegetables.
Skewer shrimp, peppers, and onion; brush with chili oil and grill until the shrimp are opaque.
ribeye-steak: A simply seared ribeye with a deeply browned crust.
Salt the steak, sear in a very hot pan, baste with butter and garlic, then rest before slicing.
silt-bean-puree: A smooth bean puree seasoned with aromatic vegetables.
Simmer white beans with onion and garlic, then blend with olive oil, lemon, and enough stock to loosen.
smoked-mirelurk-fillets: Smoky seafood fillets with a sweet-savory glaze.
Brush firm fish with paprika, brown sugar, salt, and oil; smoke or oven-roast until flaky.
squirrel-on-a-stick: A campfire skewer of small-game meat and vegetables.
Thread chicken thigh pieces and vegetables onto skewers, season boldly, and grill until fully cooked.
tato-salad: A creamy wasteland-style potato and tomato salad.
Boil diced potatoes until tender, cool, then fold with tomato, celery, herbs, mustard, and mayonnaise.
tasty-squirrel-stew: A thick camp stew of meat, vegetables, and herbs.
Brown chicken thighs, add potatoes, carrots, onion, herbs, and stock, then simmer until tender.
apple: A crisp orchard snack brightened with cinnamon and honey.
Core and slice an apple, toss with lemon juice and cinnamon, then drizzle with honey and add toasted oats.
baked-potato: A fluffy baked potato with a crisp, salted skin.
Rub a scrubbed potato with oil and salt; bake at 425°F until tender, then split and fill with butter, cheese, and chives.
beetroot: Earthy roasted beetroot with a sweet, caramelized edge.
Cut peeled beets into cubes, toss with olive oil, salt, and thyme, then roast at 400°F until fork-tender.
beetroot-soup: A vivid, velvety soup made from roasted beets.
Soften onion in butter, add roasted beets and vegetable stock, simmer briefly, then blend smooth and finish with yogurt.
bread: A simple golden loaf with a soft crumb and crisp crust.
Mix flour, yeast, warm water, and salt; knead until smooth, let rise, shape into a loaf, and bake until deeply golden.
cake: A blocky vanilla cake layered with bright white frosting.
Cream butter and sugar, beat in eggs and vanilla, fold in flour and milk, then bake and cover the cooled cake with vanilla frosting.
carrot: Sweet glazed carrots with butter and garden herbs.
Roast carrot batons with butter, honey, salt, and pepper until browned; finish with chopped parsley.
chorus-fruit: A purple End-inspired fruit salad with a tart shimmer.
Toss black grapes, blackberries, and diced plum with lime juice and honey; chill and sprinkle with sparkling sugar.
cooked-chicken: Herb-roasted chicken with crisp skin and juicy meat.
Rub chicken with oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, and pepper; roast until browned and the center reaches 165°F, then rest before serving.
cooked-cod: Tender cod baked with lemon, butter, and herbs.
Season cod with salt and pepper, dot with butter and lemon, then bake until opaque, flaky, and 145°F in the center.
cooked-mutton: Savory lamb browned with garlic and rosemary.
Season lamb chops with garlic, rosemary, salt, and pepper; sear in a hot pan and cook to your preferred safe doneness.
cooked-porkchop: A thick, juicy pork chop with a golden herb crust.
Season pork chops with paprika, thyme, salt, and pepper; sear, then finish in the oven to 145°F and rest before serving.
cooked-rabbit: A rustic herb roast inspired by Minecraft rabbit.
Brown rabbit pieces or chicken thighs, then roast with garlic, thyme, onion, and a splash of stock until tender and fully cooked.
cooked-salmon: Roasted salmon glazed with honey and lemon.
Brush salmon with honey, mustard, lemon, and oil; roast until flaky and 145°F in the center.
cookie: A crisp cocoa-studded cookie made for quick snacking.
Cream butter and sugar, mix in egg and vanilla, fold in flour and cocoa nibs or chocolate chips, then bake until the edges are golden.
dried-kelp: Thin, salty seaweed crisps with toasted sesame flavor.
Brush nori sheets lightly with sesame oil, sprinkle with salt, and bake briefly at low heat until crisp.
enchanted-golden-apple: A dramatic caramel apple sparkling with edible gold.
Dip a chilled apple in amber caramel, let it set, then brush with edible gold luster and add jewel-toned sugar sprinkles.
golden-apple: A glossy caramel apple finished with a golden crunch.
Coat an apple in warm caramel, roll it in crushed honeycomb candy and gold sanding sugar, then cool until set.
glow-berries: A luminous-looking berry compote with citrus sparkle.
Simmer blueberries and golden berries with sugar, lemon juice, and zest until glossy; cool and spoon over yogurt.
golden-carrot: Honey-roasted carrots with a warm golden glaze.
Toss carrots with honey, butter, turmeric, salt, and pepper; roast until caramelized and finish with parsley.
honey-bottle: A chilled honey-citrus drink with fresh ginger.
Shake honey with warm water until dissolved, add lemon juice and grated ginger, then chill and serve in a small bottle.
melon-slice: Cool melon wedges sharpened with lime and a pinch of chili.
Slice ripe melon into wedges, squeeze over lime, and sprinkle lightly with chili salt and chopped mint.
mushroom-stew: A creamy woodland stew packed with browned mushrooms.
Brown mixed mushrooms with onion and garlic, add vegetable stock and thyme, simmer, then finish with cream.
poisonous-potato: A safe purple-potato dish styled after Minecraft's risky crop.
Use only firm, unspoiled potatoes: boil purple potatoes until tender, mash with roasted garlic and butter, and discard any green or sprouted potatoes.
potato: Crisp skillet potatoes seasoned with onion and herbs.
Parboil diced potatoes, then fry with onion, oil, rosemary, salt, and pepper until crisp and golden.
pufferfish: A safe pufferfish-shaped rice snack with a savory filling.
Shape seasoned sushi rice around cooked salmon, add nori fins and eyes, and serve with cucumber; do not prepare real pufferfish at home.
minecraft-pumpkin-pie: A warmly spiced pumpkin custard in a flaky crust.
Whisk pumpkin puree with eggs, milk, brown sugar, cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg; pour into pastry and bake until just set.
rabbit-stew: A hearty bowl of tender meat, carrots, potatoes, and mushrooms.
Brown rabbit or chicken thighs, add carrot, potato, mushrooms, herbs, and stock, then simmer gently until tender.
raw-beef: Minecraft's raw beef reimagined as deeply browned peppered beef bites.
Cube beef, season with cracked pepper, salt, and garlic, then sear in a hot pan until browned and safely cooked.
raw-chicken: The uncooked game item transformed into crisp oven-baked chicken strips.
Coat chicken strips in seasoned breadcrumbs, bake until crisp and the center reaches 165°F, then serve with honey mustard.
raw-cod: Fresh cod transformed into golden herb fish cakes.
Mix flaked cooked cod with mashed potato, herbs, and egg; shape into cakes and pan-fry until browned and hot throughout.
raw-mutton: Mutton reimagined as warmly spiced lamb skewers.
Marinate lamb cubes with yogurt, cumin, garlic, and lemon; thread onto skewers and grill until safely cooked.
raw-porkchop: The raw game item reworked as a crisp breaded pork cutlet.
Coat a pork chop in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs; pan-sear and finish cooking to 145°F, then rest before slicing.
raw-rabbit: A rustic rabbit dish slowly braised with herbs and vegetables.
Brown rabbit pieces or chicken thighs, add onion, carrot, thyme, and stock, then cover and braise until tender and fully cooked.
raw-salmon: Fresh salmon turned into crisp, lemony fish cakes.
Combine cooked flaked salmon with breadcrumbs, egg, scallion, and lemon; shape into patties and pan-cook until golden and hot.
rotten-flesh: A safe, chewy beef-jerky stand-in for the infamous zombie drop.
Marinate thin beef strips with soy sauce, smoked paprika, and garlic, then dry in a low oven until firm and fully cooked; never use spoiled meat.
spider-eye: A playful fruit candy made to resemble a glossy spider eye.
Stuff peeled lychees with blueberries, spoon over raspberry sauce, and chill before serving.
steak: A thick pan-seared steak with garlic-herb butter.
Salt the steak, sear in a very hot pan, baste with butter, garlic, and thyme, then cook to your preferred safe doneness and rest.
suspicious-stew: A colorful mushroom stew made only with familiar edible herbs.
Brown mushrooms with onion, add stock, cream, spinach, and edible herbs, then simmer until rich; never use unidentified wild flowers or mushrooms.
sweet-berries: A sweet-tart berry compote for toast, oats, or yogurt.
Simmer mixed berries with honey, lemon, and a splash of water until juicy and slightly thickened.
tropical-fish: Colorful fish tacos layered with mango and crisp cabbage.
Season cod or tilapia with lime and paprika, cook until flaky and 145°F, then serve in tortillas with cabbage and mango salsa.
